title: helianthemum strictum
intro: Helianthemum strictum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a perennial flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum strictum are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and relax smooth muscle. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
